findings.title: Cache is not rechecked after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: The fast path checks the cache under RLock at lines 41-46, but after a goroutine waits for the exclusive lock at line 48 it unconditionally reloads the manifest and overwrites entryPointAssetsCache at line 69. Consequently, if several non-Dev requests arrive concurrently on a cold cache, every one of them performs the file read instead of all but the first reusing the newly populated cache. Add a second check after acquiring Lock (only for cfg.Env != setting.Dev, so Dev reload behavior is preserved) to return the populated cache.

findings.title: No concurrent regression test for the race fix
findings.body: The change adds synchronization to GetWebAssets but no test exercises concurrent calls, so CI running with -race has no coverage that would catch a regression of the reported data race on entryPointAssetsCache. Add a test that resets the global cache, serves a temporary assets-manifest.json, and calls GetWebAssets from many goroutines simultaneously (cold-cache non-Dev path, and ideally the Dev reload path), asserting all callers succeed with the same assets.
